mapper.select:
select c1.param_value ftrTypeCode, c2.param_value ftrType2Code, a.ftr_id as ftrId, case when length(a.ftr_id) > 20 then (select ftr_name from stt_factor where ftr_id = substr(a.ftr_id,0,instr(a.ftr_id,'-')-1))||'-'|| (select ftr_name from stt_factor where ftr_id = substr(a.ftr_id,instr(a.ftr_id,'-')+1)) else (select ftr_name from stt_factor where ftr_id = a.ftr_id) end as ftrName, d1.param_value as startDate, d2.param_value as endDate, d3.param_value as days, nvl(a.ftr_value, '数据未准备') as changeValue, PKG_STRESS_TEST_COMM.FUNC_ASSET_TYPE_NAME(e1.param_value, e2.param_value, e3.param_value) as assetTypeName, nvl2(f1.param_value, 1, 0) as mixFtr, f2.param_value as gradeCode from stt_scene_factor a, stt_scene_ftrtips c1, stt_scene_ftrtips c2, stt_scene_ftrtips d1, stt_scene_ftrtips d2, stt_scene_ftrtips d3, stt_scene_ftrtips e1, stt_scene_ftrtips e2, stt_scene_ftrtips e3, stt_scene_ftrtips f1, stt_scene_ftrtips f2 where a.scene_ftr_id = c1.scene_ftr_id and c1.dict_code = #{ftrRskType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.scene_ftr_id = c2.scene_ftr_id(+) and c2.dict_code(+) = #{ftrRskType2, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.scene_ftr_id = d1.scene_ftr_id(+) and d1.param_code(+) = #{paramDateType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and d1.dict_code(+) = #{startDateCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.scene_ftr_id = d2.scene_ftr_id(+) and d2.param_code(+) = #{paramDateType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and d2.dict_code(+) = #{endDateCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.scene_ftr_id = d3.scene_ftr_id(+) and d3.param_code(+) = #{paramNumberType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and d3.dict_code(+) = #{daysCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.scene_ftr_id = e1.scene_ftr_id(+) and e1.param_code(+) = '04' and e1.dict_code(+) = 'ASSETTYPE1' and a.scene_ftr_id = e2.scene_ftr_id(+) and e2.param_code(+) = '04' and e2.dict_code(+) = 'ASSETTYPE2' and a.scene_ftr_id = e3.scene_ftr_id(+) and e3.param_code(+) = '04' and e3.dict_code(+) = 'ASSETTYPE3' and a.scene_ftr_id = f1.scene_ftr_id(+) and f1.param_code(+) = #{paramNumberType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and f1.dict_code(+) = #{mixCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.scene_ftr_id = f2.scene_ftr_id(+) and f2.param_code(+) = '04' and f2.dict_code(+) = #{gradeCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and a.scene_id =#{sceneId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select A.SCENE_FTR_ID AS SCENEFTRID, NULL AS SCENEFTRTIPSID, A.SCENE_ID AS SCENEID, A.FTR_ID AS FTRID, A.FTR_VALUE_STRUCT AS FTRVALUESTRUCT, A.FTR_VALUE AS FTRVALUE, A.FTR_VALUE_TYPE AS FTRVALUETYPE, B1.PARAM_VALUE AS MIXFTR, B2.PARAM_VALUE AS ASSETTYPE1, B3.PARAM_VALUE AS ASSETTYPE2, B4.PARAM_VALUE AS ASSETTYPE3 from STT_SCENE_FACTOR A, STT_SCENE_FTRTIPS B1, STT_SCENE_FTRTIPS B2, STT_SCENE_FTRTIPS B3, STT_SCENE_FTRTIPS B4 where A.FTR_VALUE is null AND A.SCENE_FTR_ID = B1.SCENE_FTRTIPS_ID(+) AND B1.DICT_CODE(+) = #{mixCode} AND A.SCENE_FTR_ID = B2.SCENE_FTR_ID(+) AND B2.PARAM_CODE(+) = '04' AND B2.DICT_CODE(+) = 'ASSETTYPE1' AND A.SCENE_FTR_ID = B3.SCENE_FTR_ID(+) AND B3.PARAM_CODE(+) = '04' AND B3.DICT_CODE(+) = 'ASSETTYPE2' AND A.SCENE_FTR_ID = B4.SCENE_FTR_ID(+) AND B4.PARAM_CODE(+) = '04' AND B4.DICT_CODE(+) = 'ASSETTYPE3'
and A.SCENE_ID =#{sceneId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select t1.ftr_id as ftrId, t1.ftr_name as ftrName, t1.ftr_value_struct as frtValueStruct, t3.tips_value as ftrTypeCode, t2.tips_value as ftrType2Code, nvl(t4.type_5,nvl(t4.type_4, nvl(t4.type_3, nvl(t4.type_2, t4.type_1)))) as AssetType from stt_factor t1, stt_factor_tips t2, stt_factor_tips t3, stt_type_fac_ref t4 where t1.ftr_id = t2.ftr_id and t1.ftr_id = t3.ftr_id(+) and t2.dict_code = #{ftrType2, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and t2.tips_value in ${ftrType2Str} and t3.dict_code = #{ftrType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and t1.ftr_id = t4.fac_id(+) and (t2.tips_value != 'Mrk0101' or (t2.tips_value = 'Mrk0101' and t4.ref_id is not null))
